newsitem.title: ITALY: Second Italian train derailed, no victims.
newsitem.headline: Second Italian train derailed, no victims.

text.p: An Italian goods train with a cargo of German cars was derailed on Thursday in the second such accident in Italy within a week.

No-one was hurt when the train left the tracks near the north-eastern town of Verona and hit lights and other railway equipment. Some of the trucks carrying the cars were reported to have become dislogdged and to have fallen down an embankment.
Eight people were killed and some 25 injured when a high-speed Pendolino express train shot off the tracks in northern Italy on Sunday. The cause of both accidents was not immediately clear.

The COMU union representing Italy's train engnineers has called a strike from noon to 2 p.m. (1100-1300 GMT) on Thursday to draw attention to what it says are "lax safety checks" on the part of the state railway company.
